sar.narrative: During the period 2016-11-17 to 2016-11-17, card C03042-K1 associated with customer C03042 was subjected to unauthorized transaction activity totaling $599.94 across 1 transaction(s). Activity matched fraud typology 'card_not_present_new_device' with model risk score 0.77. TigerGraph GSQL graph neighborhood traversal uncovered multi-card entity links. The activity was flagged via TigerGraph graph traversal and verified under bank policy rules. Card C03042-K1 has been blocked and marked for replacement. Connected cards (15158) were identified and placed under monitoring to mitigate systemic exposure.
